newsitem.title: USA: Jacobs Engineering wins $131 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Jacobs Engineering wins $131 mln contract.

text.p: Jacobs Engineering Group Inc on Tuesday said it has won a $131.1 million contract from the U.S. Air Force Center for Environmental Excellence (AFCEE) to continue environmental remediations at the Massachusetts Military Reservation on Cape Cod, Mass.
The contract is an indefinite deliver, indefinite quantity agreement. It continues the Groundwater Plume Response Program that Jacobs began in fiscal 1996.
Under this contract, Jacobs will contain and treat contaminated groundwater and support future remediation decisions at the reservation.
